**What would you like to be able to do?**
A clear description of the task or question you want the dashboard to answer.
("I run a GLAM kiosk and want visitors to…")

**Which widget(s) does this involve?**
Existing widget(s) from the catalog, or "new widget".

**Have you tried building it with what exists?**
Sometimes a mix of Board Controls params, SPARQL, or a dashboard config gets
there already — if you tried, tell us what was missing. A dashboard config
(`/dashboard.json` or a `?config=` link) is worth a thousand words.

**Browser(s) you tested with** (if relevant)
Chrome / Firefox / Safari — see the browser matrix in the README.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, mockups, or links to similar tools.
